title: One-Pan Shawarma-Style Chicken and Rice
ingredients: Source Video: Shawarma Style Chicken and Rice | One Pan Recipe!
Spice Rub (Utilize 75% for chicken, reserve 25% for rice):
1.5 cups long grain or basmati rice [01:21]
Sliced raw onion or spring onion [02:06]
Synthesize Spice Blend: Combine paprika, black pepper, salt, onion powder, cumin, coriander, allspice, and turmeric thoroughly in a small bowl [00:23].

Marinate Chicken: Coat chicken thighs with roughly 75% of the spice mixture, holding back the remaining 25% [00:27]. Incorporate garlic, a small pour of olive oil, and the juice of \frac{1}{2} lemon [00:32]. Note: Marinate for a minimum of 2 hours or overnight for enhanced depth.

Sear Protein: Pre-heat a heavy pan with olive oil over medium-high heat. Add marinated chicken thighs and sear for approximately 4 to 5 minutes per side until deeply caramelized and thoroughly cooked [00:49]. Remove and set aside.
Sauté Aromatics: Reduce heat slightly. Add the sliced onion and the reserved 25% of the spice blend directly into the remaining cooking liquids and fond [01:10]. Sauté until fragrant.
Toast Grains: Add the rice to the pan, stirring constantly to coat the grains in the spiced oil and toast them lightly [01:21].

Deglaze & Simmer: Pour in the chicken stock and add the remaining lemon juice [01:26]. Bring the mixture to a rapid boil, cover securely with a lid, drop heat to a low simmer, and cook undisturbed for 10 minutes [01:43].

Assemble: Slice the reserved chicken thighs and arrange over the cooked rice. Top with raw sliced onion or spring onion to cut through the heavily spiced profile [02:06]. Compatible with a side yogurt sauce or fresh tomato salad.
